mapper.insert: insert into coop_complaint (topic_id, registration_id, reporter_member_id, respondent_type, respondent_member_id, status, advance_amount, fault_ratio, deduct_amount, reason, handle_note, handler_id, create_time, update_time, del_flag) values (#{topicId}, #{registrationId}, #{reporterMemberId}, #{respondentType}, #{respondentMemberId}, #{status}, #{advanceAmount}, #{faultRatio}, #{deductAmount}, #{reason}, #{handleNote}, #{handlerId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{delFlag})
mapper.update: update coop_complaint set status = 3, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and status = #{expectedStatus} and status < 3 and del_flag = 0
mapper.select: select count(*) from coop_complaint where del_flag = 0 and topic_id = #{topicId} and status < 3

select c.id, c.topic_id as topicId, t.name as topicName, c.status, c.advance_amount as advanceAmount, c.reason, c.handle_note as handleNote, c.create_time as createTime, c.update_time as updateTime from coop_complaint c left join cms_topic t on t.id = c.topic_id where c.reporter_member_id = #{memberId} and c.del_flag = 0 order by c.id desc
